description: This file defines the 'FeatureDefinitionCreated' event class, which represents an event emitted after a Feature's FeatureDefinition is created within an Eclipse Ditto-based IoT framework. The class includes methods for constructing the event from parameters or JSON, and provides accessors for the feature ID and definition, as well as serialization support.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class representing the creation of a feature definition within a thing, including JSON serialization/deserialization and metadata handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of FeatureDefinitionCreated with detailed parameters, including optional timestamp and metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the event.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature associated with the event.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the feature definition that was created.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new event instance with an updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new event instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the feature definition.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path for this event resource.
